provenance.notes: Buffer-sharing INT8 decode. The bandwidth metric counts the portable physical minimum: WebGPU exposes each logical INT8 cache element through i32 storage, the past cache is preserved into present K/V, and attention reads K/V once per KV head. It intentionally does not credit duplicate cache reads across grouped query heads.
